and notional exchanges) in payment order.

quantra_QuantoSpec.description:
Quanto treatment of one basket underlying whose currency differs from the
note currency: the note pays in its own currency the performance of an
index quoted in another one, so the simulated drift of that index is
r_note - q - rho * sigma_S * sigma_FX (QuantLib QuantoTermStructure) while
the index keeps its own units. Present iff the underlying's currency
differs from `StructuredNote.currency` (400 either way otherwise: a
quanto block on a same-currency underlying, or none on a foreign one).

discounting_curve.description:
Id of the discount curve of the UNDERLYING's currency in
pricing.rates.curves: the risk-neutral drift of the underlying in its
own currency (r_local in the quanto adjustment). The note-currency
curve is `StructuredNote.discounting_curve`. Required.

fx_spot_id.description:
Id of the `FxSpotSpec` in pricing.fx.spots for the underlying's
currency against the note currency, in either direction (the engine
inverts when base/quote are the other way round). Required.

fx_volatility_id.description:
Id of the `VolSurfaceSpec` (BlackVolSpec payload, Constant or term)
in pricing.volatility.vol_surfaces holding the volatility of that FX
rate; used only for the quanto drift adjustment. Required.

fx_underlying_correlation.description:
Correlation between the underlying and the FX rate (underlying
currency per unit of note currency, i.e. the rate that rises when
the note currency strengthens against the underlying's currency), in
[-1, 1]. A scalar input: the FX rate is not simulated and this
correlation is not read from the correlation matrix. Presence-
required (a bare double would silently mean 0 = no adjustment).

quantra_BasketUnderlying.description:
One underlying of a basket: an equity index (or share) from the shared
equity market data, its volatility, the level it was struck at, and the
closes already observed for a seasoned note.

underlying_id.description:
Id of the `EquityUnderlyingSpec` in pricing.equity.equity_underlyings
(spot quote, dividend curve, currency). Required.

volatility_id.description:
Id of the `VolSurfaceSpec` (BlackVolSpec payload) in
pricing.volatility.vol_surfaces: constant, term, or strike x expiry
surface (a surface makes the simulation local-vol and requires
`MonteCarloSpec.steps_per_year`). Required.

initial_level.description:
Strike fixing from the term sheet: the closing level on the strike
date that every performance S(t) / initial_level is measured against.
Presence-required and > 0.

historical_levels.description:
Closing levels on past observation dates (seasoned notes): one
`Fixing` (date, value > 0) per observation event whose
`observation_date` is on or before the valuation date and that
carries a trigger. Events before the valuation date are resolved from
these, never simulated; a past observation without a level is a 400
naming the date and the underlying. Accrual-only events need no
level. Levels on other dates are ignored.

quantra_ObservationEvent.description:
One date of the note's life. Which tests run at an event is decided by
which triggers are present; the coupon of the event is `coupon`
(fraction of notional). The basket performance perf = rule over
S_i(observation_date) / initial_level_i, and every test is "perf >=
trigger" (triggers are fractions of the initial level: 1.0 = 100%).

autocall_trigger present, coupon_trigger absent (classic autocall):
the coupon test IS the call test. perf >= autocall_trigger: notional
plus this event's coupon plus every unpaid coupon in the memory is
paid on `payment_date` and the note ends. Otherwise nothing is paid
and, with `CouponRule.memory`, `coupon` joins the memory.
autocall_trigger present, coupon_trigger present (Phoenix with a call):
coupon test first: perf >= coupon_trigger earns this event's coupon
plus the memory (paid on `payment_date`, or held until the next call
when `CouponRule.pay_only_on_call`); otherwise the coupon joins the
memory. Then the call test: perf >= autocall_trigger pays the
notional plus everything held, on `payment_date`, and the note ends.
autocall_trigger absent, coupon_trigger present (coupon-only date):
the coupon test only, as above; the note cannot end here.
both absent (accrual-only period):
nothing is observed and nothing is paid: `coupon` is added to the
memory. This encodes a snowball coupon that accrues from the strike
date while the first observation is later (a 7% semi-annual coupon
first observed at 12 months pays 2 x 7% on the first call). Requires
`CouponRule.memory` = true (400 otherwise: nothing could carry the
coupon) and `payment_date` absent (400 when present).

The last event is the final observation: its tests run as above, and
when the note has not ended there the capital test of
`CapitalProtection` runs on the same perf and the redemption is paid on
`StructuredNote.maturity_payment_date`. A final event with no trigger at
all is a 400. Events must be in strictly increasing `observation_date`
order; events on or before the valuation date are resolved from
`BasketUnderlying.historical_levels` and never simulated.

observation_date.description:
Date the basket is observed (closing levels), ISO. Required. For an
accrual-only event (no triggers) nothing is observed: the date is
nominal and only orders the event among the others.

payment_date.description:
Date a coupon or call triggered here is paid, ISO, on or after
`observation_date`. Required (400) whenever `autocall_trigger` or
`coupon_trigger` is present; must be absent for an accrual-only
event.

coupon_trigger.description:
Coupon trigger as a fraction of the initial level; perf >= trigger
earns the coupon. Absent = no coupon test of its own (with an
`autocall_trigger` the coupon is earned by the call test; with
neither trigger the event is accrual-only).

coupon.description:
Coupon of this period as a fraction of notional (0.07 = 7%).
Required (400) when `coupon_trigger` is present or the event is
accrual-only. With only an `autocall_trigger` it may be absent: the
event then carries no coupon of its own and a call pays the notional
plus the memory only.

quantra_CouponRule.description: How coupons that were earned or missed carry over between events.

memory.description:
True: a coupon not paid at its event (test failed, or held because
`pay_only_on_call`) is added to a memory that is paid in full with
the next coupon that is paid; the memory is a sum of coupon amounts,
so events may carry different coupons. False: a missed coupon is
lost. Presence-required.

pay_only_on_call.description:
True (Athena / snowball): coupons are paid only when the note ends
(a call, or the final event); an earned coupon at a non-calling
event is held in the memory. False (Phoenix): an earned coupon is
paid on its event's `payment_date`. Presence-required.

quantra_CapitalProtection.description:
Capital protection at the final observation. With perf the basket
performance on the final observation date (or, with DailyClose
monitoring, breach = any close below the barrier over the life), the
redemption is notional x 1 when the barrier holds and
notional x (1 - participation x max(put_strike - perf_final, 0)) when it
is breached, paid on `StructuredNote.maturity_payment_date`.

barrier.description:
Barrier as a fraction of the initial level (0.6 = 60%); the capital
is at risk when perf < barrier. Presence-required and in (0, 1].

put_strike.description:
Strike of the embedded put as a fraction of the initial level
(1.0 = loss measured from 100%, the "1-for-1" of a factsheet).

knocked_in.description:
Whether a DailyClose barrier has already been breached before the
valuation date. Presence-required (400) when `monitoring` is
DailyClose and any event precedes the valuation date (the engine
cannot infer it from `historical_levels`, which hold observation
dates only); must be absent otherwise.

quantra_UpsideParticipation.description:
Optional upside at the final observation when the note has not called:
adds `participation * max(perf - strike, 0)` of the notional, capped at
`cap` when present. Expresses bonus certificates, capped participation
notes and twin-win structures; absent for a plain autocallable.

strike.description: Strike as a fraction of the initial level. Presence-required.

participation.description: Participation in the performance above the strike. Presence-required.

cap.description:
Maximum upside as a fraction of the notional (0.3 = at most +30%).
Absent = uncapped.

quantra_MonteCarloSpec.description:
Monte Carlo settings. Every price carries its standard error, path
count and seed, and Greeks are computed by bump-and-reprice on the same
random stream.

paths.description:
Number of simulated paths (antithetic pairs count as two paths).
Presence-required and > 0; a power of two is recommended with Sobol.

seed.description: Seed of the random sequence (Sobol scrambling / Mersenne Twister).

antithetic.description: Antithetic variates (every Gaussian draw is also used negated).

brownian_bridge.description: Brownian-bridge ordering of the draws (recommended with Sobol).

steps_per_year.description:
Time steps per year of the simulation grid between observation
dates. Required (400) when any underlying's volatility is a strike x
expiry surface (local-vol evolution) or the capital barrier is
monitored DailyClose; otherwise must be absent and the grid is the
observation dates only (exact lognormal steps). Between observation
dates the processes evolve with log-Euler steps of 1/steps_per_year
years. A DailyClose barrier is tested on the simulated closes only:
set this to the index's trading days per year (about 252); fewer
steps under-sample the barrier and bias the price. No continuity
correction (Broadie-Glasserman-Kou) is applied, because the barrier
is discrete by contract.

quantra_StructuredNote.description:
A structured note on a basket of equity indices: a strip of observation
events (autocall and/or coupon tests on the basket performance), a coupon
carry rule, and capital protection at maturity. Classic and snowball
autocalls, low-hurdle finals, Phoenix coupons, step-down triggers and
geared puts are all configurations of these fields; there is one payoff
walk, not one product per shape. Priced by Monte Carlo under correlated
Black-Scholes (or local-vol) dynamics with quanto drift adjustments,
discounted on `discounting_curve` plus `funding_spread_bp`.

trade_id.description: Trade identifier echoed in the response. Required.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code of the note currency (coupons, redemption, NPV).
Required.

notional.description:
Notional (denomination x units); coupons and the redemption are
fractions of it. Presence-required and > 0.

underlyings.description:
The basket. Required; at least one entry; ids distinct; with two or
more entries the set of `underlying_id`s must equal the labels of the
correlation matrix `correlation_id`.

events.description:
The note's dates in strictly increasing `observation_date` order; the
last one is the final observation. Required; at least one entry.

maturity_payment_date.description:
Date the redemption is paid when the note reaches the final
observation without a call, ISO, on or after the final
`observation_date`. Required.

discounting_curve.description:
Id of the note-currency discount curve in pricing.rates.curves
(OIS or funding curve). Required.

funding_spread_bp.description:
Issuer funding spread in basis points added to `discounting_curve`
as a flat zero spread (QuantLib ZeroSpreadedTermStructure) for
discounting every cash flow. 0 = discount on the curve as is.

correlation_id.description:
Id of the `CorrelationMatrixSpec` in pricing.correlations.matrices;
its labels must be exactly the basket's underlying ids. Required
(400) when the note has two or more underlyings; must be absent (400)
with exactly one underlying, which is simulated on a 1 x 1 unit
matrix (a `CorrelationMatrixSpec` lists at least two labels).

quantra_StructuredNoteGreeksSpec.description:
Opt-in Greeks by bump-and-reprice on the same random stream (common
random numbers): every bump re-runs the full simulation with the same
seed, paths, grid and sequence, so the cost is (1 + 2N + N + 3) runs for
N underlyings (1 + 2 + 1 + 2 for a single underlying, which has no
correlation sensitivity). Absent = no Greeks (the response's `greeks`
block is absent). Every bump has a default; the sizes are echoed in the
response and the reported sensitivities are scaled to unit moves (1%,
1 vol point, 0.01, 1bp) and each carries the standard error of its
per-path difference. Definitions: the doc comments of
`StructuredNoteGreeks` in structured_note_response.fbs. A `greeks` block
on a note whose past already decided it (`Called` / `Matured`) is a 400.

spot_bump.description:
Relative spot bump per underlying (0.01 = +/-1%), for delta (central)
and gamma. Must be finite and > 0 (400 otherwise).

vol_bump.description:
Absolute volatility bump per underlying in vol units (0.01 = +1 vol
point), for vega. Must be finite and > 0.

correlation_bump.description:
Absolute bump of every off-diagonal correlation (0.01 = +0.01), for
the correlation sensitivity; the bumped entries are clipped to
[-1, 1] and the matrix is repaired to positive semi-definite by
eigenvalue clipping when needed (the response says so and returns
the matrix used). Must be finite and > 0.

funding_bump_bp.description:
Funding-spread bump in basis points, for funding_dv01. Must be
finite and > 0.

rate_bump_bp.description:
Parallel bump of the discount curve in basis points, for rho. Must
be finite and > 0.

quantra_StructuredNoteDiagnosticsSpec.description:
Opt-in diagnostic blocks, each computed from the SAME paths as the
price so the parts add up to the headline (the terms echo, the
seasoning resolution and the model echo are always returned). Absent =
no diagnostic block.

market.description:
Market as used: per underlying spot, forwards and vols at every
observation date, quanto drift; discount factors at every payment
date with and without the funding spread; the correlation matrix.

decomposition.description:
Per event call/coupon probabilities and PV paid there, survival and
breach probabilities, expected life, expected loss given breach.

checks.description:
Convergence (running mean at 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 of the paths), the
zero-vol price along the forward path, limit prices with
correlation forced to 1 and to 0 (one extra run each), and the
bond-only value.

distribution.description:
Quantiles of the basket performance per observation date, quantiles
and a histogram of the total payout per path, and `sample_paths`
individual paths.

timing.description:
Milliseconds per stage (market build, path generation, payoff walk,
each Greek).

sample_paths.description:
Number of individual paths returned with `distribution` (basket
performance per event, payout, call date), capped at 100; 0 = none.
Raw underlying levels are never returned.

quantra_PriceStructuredNoteRequest.description:
Request to price one or more structured notes against one market. Each
note is simulated on its own (paths are not shared between notes).

notes.description: The notes, in response order. Required; at least one entry.

quantra_VanillaSwap.description:
Vanilla interest rate swap: a fixed leg against an IBOR or CMS floating
leg, both `SwapLeg`s in one currency (400 when the currencies differ:
two currencies are a cross-currency swap), one paid and one received
(`SwapLeg.pay_receive`; 400 when both take the same side). The legs name
their own discounting and forwarding curves. Each leg is priced as a
QuantLib leg on its own discount curve: FixedRateLeg / IborLeg (the
chains QuantLib::VanillaSwap builds, with a zero-volatility Black pricer
on the IBOR coupons) or CmsLeg with the requested CMS pricer, plus the
notional exchanges when a leg asks for them (see `VanillaSwapResponse`).

exercise_date.description: Single exercise date (ISO date string). Required for European and American.

exercise_dates.description: Bermudan exercise date set (ISO date strings). Required for Bermudan; must contain at least 2 dates.

underlying.description:
Underlying swap instrument (see `SwaptionUnderlying`). Required; in
JSON `"underlying_type": "VanillaSwap"` precedes `"underlying"`.

quantra_PriceSwaption.description:
One swaption to price with its vol and model references. The curves come
from the underlying swap's legs (`SwapLeg.discounting_curve`, which both
legs must name identically, and the floating / overnight leg's
`forwarding_curve`); every reference is by id into `pricing`.

volatility.description: Reference to volatility in pricing.volatility.vol_surfaces by id.

model.description: Reference to model in pricing.volatility.models by id.

quantra_PriceSwaptionRequest.description: Request to price one or more swaptions.

include_diagnostics.description:
When true, the response carries one SwaptionVolDiagnostics block per
unique SABR-kind vol surface referenced by `swaptions`. Default false.

quantra_PriceVanillaSwap.description:
One vanilla swap to price. The legs name their own discounting and
forwarding curves (`SwapLeg`); every reference is by id into `pricing`.
The NPV is reported in the legs' currency.

quantra_PriceVanillaSwapRequest.description: Request to price one or more vanilla swaps against one market.

include_flows.description:
When true every response row lists each leg's future flows (coupons
and notional exchanges) in payment order.

quantra_YoYInflationCapFloor.description:
Year-on-year inflation cap / floor / collar (QuantLib::YoYInflationCapFloor).
A strip of year-on-year inflation optionlets built over `schedule` off the
same YoY inflation index/curve the year-on-year inflation swap path uses.

The pricing formula is selected by the referenced YoYOptionletVolSpec's
vol_type (Black / UnitDisplacedBlack / Bachelier); the vol surface and this
instrument reference the SAME year-on-year inflation index by id.

notional.description: Notional per optionlet. Presence-required and must be > 0.

inflation_index_id.description:
Link to InflationIndexSpec.id — the YoY inflation index (must resolve to
a QuantLib YoYInflationIndex, same as the year-on-year inflation swap).

cap_rate.description:
Cap strike (year-on-year rate). Required when, and only when, the type
is Cap or Collar; must be absent for a Floor.

floor_rate.description:
Floor strike (year-on-year rate). Required when, and only when, the type
is Floor or Collar; must be absent for a Cap. For a Collar,
cap_rate >= floor_rate is enforced.

gearing.description: Optional per-optionlet gearing on the year-on-year rate (absent => 1.0).

spread.description:
Optional per-optionlet spread added to the year-on-year rate
(absent => 0.0).

quantra_PriceYoYInflationCapFloor.description:
Single year-on-year inflation cap/floor pricing context with explicit
market-data references.

discounting_curve.description:
Reference to curve in Pricing.rates.curves used for discounting and as
the nominal term structure fed to the engine.

inflation_curve.description:
Reference to curve in Pricing.inflation.inflation_curves (the YoY
inflation curve the index projects off).

volatility.description:
Reference to the YoYOptionletVolSpec id in
Pricing.volatility.vol_surfaces.

quantra_PriceYearOnYearInflationCapFloor.description: Request to price one or more year-on-year inflation cap/floor trades.

quantra_PriceYearOnYearInflationSwap.description: Single YYIIS pricing context with explicit market-data references.

quantra_PriceYearOnYearInflationSwapRequ.description: Request to price one or more YYIIS trades.

quantra_ZeroCouponBond.description:
Zero-coupon bond instrument. Pays a single redemption cashflow at maturity
and carries no periodic coupons, so it needs no schedule.

settlement_days.description: Number of days between trade and settlement.

face_amount.description:
Notional / face amount the redemption percentage applies to.
Presence-required and must be > 0 (a bare double would default to a
silent zero face).

redemption.description:
Redemption as a percentage of face (e.g. 100.0 = par). Optional:
presence decides. Absent => QuantLib's 100.0 (par) default.

issue_date.description: Optional issue date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd). Absent => QuantLib's null Date.

discounting_curve.description: Reference to curve in pricing.rates.curves by id.

quantra_PriceZeroCouponBondRequest.description: Request to price one or more zero-coupon bonds.

maturity_date.description: Contract maturity date before any internal observation adjustment.

adjust_observation_dates.description:
Must stay false. In the pinned QuantLib this flag does not change the
priced observation dates for a zero-coupon inflation swap, so setting it
true would be a silent no-op; the server rejects true with an error
rather than accept a flag it cannot honour.

quantra_PriceZeroCouponInflationSwap.description: Single ZCIIS pricing context with explicit market-data references.

quantra_PriceZeroCouponInflationSwapRequ.description: Request to price one or more ZCIIS trades.

quantra_ZeroCouponSwap.description:
Zero-coupon interest rate swap (QuantLib::ZeroCouponSwap). Exchanges a
single fixed cashflow at maturity against a single compounded-floating
cashflow. The fixed side is quoted EITHER as a known fixed payment amount
OR as a fixed rate compounded over the contract life.

base_nominal.description:
Base notional prior to compounding. Presence-required and must be > 0
(a bare double would default to a silent zero notional).

fixed_payment.description:
Fixed-payment form: the known fixed cash flow N^FIX. Optional; presence
selects this quoting form. Exactly one of `fixed_payment` or the
`fixed_rate`+`fixed_rate_day_counter` pair must be supplied.

fixed_rate.description:
Fixed-rate form: the fixed rate R compounded over the contract life as
N^FIX = N[(1+R)^alpha - 1], alpha the fixed_rate_day_counter year
fraction between start and maturity. Optional; presence selects this
quoting form. QuantLib's ZeroCouponSwap rate constructor takes only the
rate and its day counter (compounding is implicitly annual and there is
no coupon frequency), so no compounding/frequency fields are exposed.

payment_delay.description: Number of business days the payment is delayed after maturity.

discounting_curve.description: Reference to curve in pricing.rates.curves for discounting by id.

forwarding_curve.description:
Reference to curve in pricing.rates.curves for floating-leg forward
rates by id.

quantra_PriceZeroCouponSwapRequest.description: Request to price one or more zero-coupon swaps.

quantra_StrikeGrid.description: Strike grid for vol surface sampling.

swap_index_id.description: Optional override; must match surface swap_index_id if provided.

slice_expiry_index.description: Slice selectors (only used by slice modes). -1 means "not set".

slice_strike_is_set.description: Strict mode requires true for slice modes using slice_strike.

discounting_curve_id.description: Required for SpreadFromATM swaption surfaces to compute ATM forwards.

requested_expiry_grid_points.description: Optional grid points after grid conventions.

effective_swap_starts.description: Swaptions flattened i_expiry major then j_tenor.

vols.description: Flattening: swaptions Cube i_expiry major, j_tenor, k_strike; optionlets Cube i_expiry major, k_strike.

atm_levels.description: Optional flattened ATM levels (par swap rates), i_expiry major then j_tenor. Populated when strike kind is SpreadFromATM.

quantra_SampleVolSurfacesRequest.description: Request to sample volatility surfaces according to query specs.

include_diagnostics.description:
When true, the response carries one SwaptionVolDiagnostics block per
unique SABR-kind vol surface referenced by `queries`. Default false to
keep wire size and serialization cost down for clients that don't need it.

quantra_SampleVolSurfacesResponse.description: Response from volatility surface sampling request.

diagnostics.description:
Per-surface diagnostics, one entry per unique SABR-kind vol surface
referenced by the request. Populated only when the request sets
`include_diagnostics=true`. Empty/absent otherwise.

quantra_StructuredNoteTermsUnderlying.description: One basket underlying as the engine booked it.

initial_level.description: Strike level the performances are measured against.

quanto.description: True when the underlying is quanto'd into the note currency.

fx_spot_id.description:
FX spot id of the quanto block; absent for a same-currency
underlying.

fx_volatility_id.description:
FX volatility id of the quanto block; absent for a same-currency
underlying.

fx_underlying_correlation.description:
Underlying/FX correlation of the quanto block; absent for a
same-currency underlying.

quantra_StructuredNoteTermsEvent.description: One observation event as the engine booked it (request order).

autocall_trigger.description: Absent = no call test at this event.

coupon_trigger.description: Absent = no coupon test of its own at this event.

coupon.description: Absent = no coupon of its own at this event.

accrual_only.description: True for an event with neither trigger (coupon accrues to memory).

final.description: True for the last event (capital test runs here).

resolved_from_history.description:
True when `observation_date` is on or before the valuation date:
the event was resolved from `historical_levels` (see
`StructuredNoteSeasoning`) and not simulated.

quantra_StructuredNoteTermsEcho.description:
The booked terms as the engine understood them: a mis-read factsheet is
visible here before the price is trusted. Always present. Defaults are
filled in (put_strike, participation, funding spread, Monte Carlo
settings).

correlation_id.description:
Absent for a single-underlying note (simulated on a 1 x 1 unit
matrix).

paths.description: Paths requested (the number actually simulated is on the result).

steps_per_year.description: Absent when the grid is the observation dates only.

quantra_StructuredNoteResolvedEvent.description: One past event evaluated on the supplied historical levels.

accrual_only.description:
True for an accrual-only event (no levels read; coupon added to the
memory).

levels.description:
Closing levels used, one per underlying in `terms.underlyings`
order; empty for an accrual-only event.

performances.description:
Level / initial level, one per underlying; empty for an accrual-only
event.

basket_performance.description:
Basket performance under `performance_rule`; absent for an
accrual-only event.

called.description: Call test outcome; absent when the event has no `autocall_trigger`.

coupon_earned.description:
Coupon test outcome (or, with only an `autocall_trigger`, the call
test); absent when the event carries no coupon test.

coupon_paid.description:
Coupon amount (fraction of notional) paid on this event's payment
date, memory included; 0 when nothing was paid.

memory_after.description: Coupon memory (fraction of notional) carried out of this event.

quantra_StructuredNoteSeasoning.description:
How the note's past was resolved before anything was simulated. Always
present (empty `events` for a note with no past event).

as_of_date.description: Valuation date the past/future split was made on.

memory_carried.description: Coupon memory (fraction of notional) entering the simulation.

next_event_index.description:
Index of the first simulated event; absent when none (Called or
Matured).

known_payment_date.description:
For a Called or Matured note: the known payment date and amount
(fraction of notional, redemption and coupons together). The NPV
is that amount discounted when the date is after the valuation
date, 0 otherwise. Absent for an Alive note.

quantra_StructuredNoteModelUnderlying.description: The model used for one underlying.

local_vol.description:
True when the paths were evolved under Dupire local volatility
derived from a surface.

quanto_drift.description:
Quanto drift adjustment -rho * sigma_S * sigma_FX applied
(annualised, in rate units, at the first observation); absent for a
same-currency underlying.

quantra_StructuredNoteModelEcho.description: The simulation set-up as used. Always present.

observation_dates_only.description: True when the time grid is the (future) observation dates only.

time_steps.description: Number of time steps of the grid.

time_grid.description:
The grid, in years from the valuation date (day counter of the
discounting curve).

sequence_dimension.description: Dimension of the random sequence (time steps x underlyings).

quantra_StructuredNoteBucket.description:
Present value of one cash-flow bucket, from the same paths as the
headline NPV, with its own standard error.

pv.description: PV in the note currency (capital_loss is <= 0).

quantra_StructuredNoteLegs.description:
NPV split by cash-flow bucket; the three sum to the headline `npv` to
rounding.

quantra_StructuredNoteEventProbability.description: Call and coupon probabilities of one simulated event.

p_call.description:
Probability that the note is alive at this event and the call test
holds; absent when the event has no `autocall_trigger`.

p_coupon.description:
Probability that the note is alive at this event and a coupon is
earned (paid or held); absent when the event carries no coupon test.

quantra_StructuredNoteUnderlyingGreeks.description:
Sensitivities of one underlying by bump-and-reprice on common random
numbers (every bumped run uses the same seed, paths, grid and random
sequence as the price), in the note currency, scaled to unit moves. Each
sensitivity carries the Monte Carlo standard error of the DIFFERENCE
(accumulated per path, not the difference of two standard errors), which
is what the common random numbers make small.

delta.description:
NPV change per +1% move of the spot: central difference of the spot
bumped by +/- `spot_bump` (relative), (V+ - V-) / (2 spot_bump) x
0.01. Only the spot quote moves: the initial level (strike fixing),
the dividend curve and the volatility (sticky strike for a surface)
stay.

gamma.description:
Change of `delta` per +1% move of the spot: (V+ - 2 V0 + V-) /
spot_bump^2 x 0.01^2.

vega.description:
NPV change per +1 vol point: the underlying's Black volatility
shifted by +`vol_bump` (absolute; a constant vol, every node of a
term vol, every entry of a strike x expiry surface, from which the
local vol is re-derived), (V(sigma + vol_bump) - V0) / vol_bump x
0.01. For a quanto underlying the shifted vol also enters the quanto
drift (-rho x sigma_S x sigma_FX).

quantra_StructuredNoteGreeks.description:
Opt-in Greeks (absent unless `greeks` was in the request). Cost: 1 + 2N
+ N + 3 full simulations for N underlyings (2 for a single underlying,
which has no correlation sensitivity), all on the same random stream.

correlation_sensitivity.description:
NPV change per +0.01 on every off-diagonal correlation: every
off-diagonal entry shifted by +`correlation_bump`, clipped to
[-1, 1], (V(rho + bump) - V0) / correlation_bump x 0.01. Absent for a
single underlying.

correlation_bump_repaired.description:
True when the bumped correlation matrix was not positive
semi-definite and was repaired before repricing: eigenvalue
clipping (negative eigenvalues set to 0, V diag(max(lambda, 0)) V^T)
followed by a rescaling to unit diagonal. False for a single
underlying.

correlation_bumped.description:
The correlation matrix the bumped run used (after clipping and, when
`correlation_bump_repaired`, the repair), row-major n x n in the
note's underlying order. Absent for a single underlying.

funding_dv01.description:
NPV change per +1bp of funding spread: the spread shifted by
+`funding_bump_bp` on the discounting only (the processes drift on
the plain curve), (V(s + bump) - V0) / funding_bump_bp.

rho.description:
NPV change per +1bp parallel move of `discounting_curve`: a
continuously compounded zero spread of +`rate_bump_bp` on the note
curve, applied both to the processes' risk-free rate (the drift of a
note-currency underlying; a quanto underlying's drift is r_local - q
- rho sigma_S sigma_FX and does not move, its quanto curve is
rebuilt on the shifted note curve) and to the discounting of every
cash flow, the funding spread staying on top; (V(r + bump) - V0) /
rate_bump_bp.

spot_bump.description: Bump sizes used, as requested or defaulted.

quantra_StructuredNoteMarketUnderlying.description:
Market as used for one underlying, one entry per simulated observation
date (the `observation_dates` of the parent block). Deterministic: read
from the curves and vols the processes were built on, no simulation.

forwards.description:
Forward level at each observation date: spot x D_div(t) / D_note(t)
with D_div the process's dividend curve (the QuantoTermStructure for
a quanto underlying, so the quanto drift is included) and D_note the
note's discounting curve without the funding spread, both at the
Actual/365 (Fixed) time t of the simulation grid. This is the level
the deterministic forward walk of `checks` uses.

implied_dividend_yields.description:
Continuously-compounded dividend yield of the underlying's own
dividend curve (quanto adjustment excluded) implied between
consecutive observation dates, the first from the valuation date:
-ln(D(t_j) / D(t_{j-1})) / (t_j - t_{j-1}).

implied_rates.description:
Continuously-compounded rate of the underlying's own currency (the
quanto block's `discounting_curve`, or the note curve for a
same-currency underlying) implied between consecutive observation
dates, as above.

atm_vols.description:
Black volatility used to each observation date at the forward of
that date (ATM).

barrier_vols.description:
Black volatility used to each observation date at the capital
barrier strike, `capital.barrier x initial_level`. Equals
`atm_vols` for a constant or term vol (`model.underlyings[].local_vol`
false): the strike is only read on a strike x expiry surface.

quanto_drift_bp.description:
Quanto drift adjustment applied, -rho x sigma_S x sigma_FX in basis
points per year, with sigma_S the underlying's Black vol at
`initial_level` and sigma_FX the FX vol at the FX spot, both to the
final simulated observation date; rho in QuantLib's convention
(correlation with the FX rate quoted as underlying-currency units per
note-currency unit). Absent for a same-currency underlying.

payment_dates.description:
Every future payment date, in order: the payment date of each
simulated event followed by `maturity_payment_date` when it is not
already the last one.

discount_factors.description: Discount factor on `discounting_curve` at each payment date.

discount_factors_with_funding.description: Discount factor with the funding spread at each payment date.

correlation_labels.description: Labels of the correlation matrix as used (underlying order).

correlation.description:
The correlation matrix as used, row-major n x n, permuted to the
note's underlying order; the 1 x 1 unit matrix for a single
underlying. No repair is ever applied (a matrix that is not positive
semi-definite is a 400).

quantra_StructuredNoteEventDecomposition.description:
`diagnostics.decomposition`: one simulated event (accrual-only events
are not listed: nothing is observed or paid on them).

p_call.description:
Absent when the event has no `autocall_trigger` (same value as
`event_probabilities`).

p_coupon.description:
Absent when the event carries no coupon test (same value as
`event_probabilities`).

pv_coupons.description:
PV, in the note currency, of the coupons paid on this event's
payment date (memory included), averaged over the paths.

pv_redemption.description:
PV, in the note currency, of the notional returned on this event's
payment date (a call), or, on the final event, of the redemption
before any loss (upside included) on `maturity_payment_date`.

quantra_StructuredNoteDecompositionDiagn.description:
`diagnostics.decomposition`. The event PVs add up to the buckets:
sum(pv_coupons) = legs.coupons.pv and sum(pv_redemption) =
legs.bond_redemption.pv, less any flow the past already fixed (listed
in `seasoning`, not here); the capital loss is on `legs.capital_loss`
with its standard error, as are the bucket standard errors.

p_survive_to_maturity.description: Probability that the note is not called before the final event.

p_breach.description: Probability that the capital barrier is breached.

expected_life_years.description: Expected time to the note's end, in years from the valuation date.

expected_loss_given_breach.description:
Expected loss conditional on a breach, as a positive fraction of the
notional, undiscounted: E[loss x 1{breach}] / p_breach with loss =
participation x max(put_strike - perf_final, 0). Absent when no path
breached (p_breach = 0).

quantra_StructuredNoteRunningMean.description:
Running estimate of the NPV after a fraction of the samples, in
simulation order (an antithetic pair is one sample).

fraction.description:
Fraction of the samples used (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0; a fraction is
omitted when its sample count would be 0 or repeat the previous
one).

paths.description: Simulated paths used (samples, or 2 x samples with antithetic).

npv.description: NPV estimate over those paths, in the note currency.

standard_error.description: Its standard error (the same estimator as the headline's).

deterministic_forward_npv.description:
Price of the payoff walked once along the forward path: every
underlying at its `market` forward on every grid date (zero
volatility), the same state machine as the simulation, no random
numbers.

correlation_one_npv.description:
Price with every off-diagonal correlation forced to 1 (one extra run
on the same random stream, paths, seed and grid). With a single
underlying it is the headline price (no extra run).

correlation_zero_npv.description:
Price with every off-diagonal correlation forced to 0 (the identity
matrix; one extra run on the same stream). With a single underlying
it is the headline price (no extra run).

bond_only_npv.description:
notional x discount factor (funding spread included) at
`maturity_payment_date`: the value of the note if it were a
zero-coupon bond of the issuer.

quantra_StructuredNoteQuantiles.description:
Quantiles of the basket performance (`performance_rule` applied) at one
simulated observation date, over every simulated path: each path of an
antithetic pair counts on its own (the pairs are averaged for the price
statistics only). Quantile definition: linear interpolation between
order statistics, q(p) = x[h] + (h - floor(h)) x (x[floor(h) + 1] -
x[floor(h)]) with h = (n - 1) x p on the ascending values x[0..n-1]
(the default of R and NumPy). The basket performance is recorded at the
observation date whether or not the note is still alive on that path.

quantra_StructuredNoteHistogramBin.description:
One bin of the payout histogram: 20 bins of equal width between the
smallest and the largest payout over the paths, edges lower_k = min +
k x (max - min) / 20. When every path pays the same amount all 20 bins
have zero width and every path is in the first one.

upper.description: Upper edge, exclusive (inclusive for the last bin).

paths.description: Simulated paths in the bin; the bins sum to the result's `paths`.

quantra_StructuredNoteSamplePath.description: One simulated path, summarised (raw levels are never returned).

basket_performances.description:
Basket performance at each simulated observation date (the
`observation_date`s of `basket_performance_quantiles`), recorded
whether or not the note is still alive on that date.

payout.description:
Undiscounted total payout of the path, fraction of notional:
every coupon and redemption paid after the valuation date on this
path, loss and upside included, plus any flow the past already
fixed (identical on every path).

payout_pv.description:
The same payout discounted on the funding curve, fraction of
notional; its average over the paths is npv / notional.

called_on.description:
Observation date of the call; absent when the path reached the
final event.

breached.description: True when the capital barrier was breached.

quantra_StructuredNoteDistributionDiagno.description:
`diagnostics.distribution`. Every statistic is over the individual
simulated paths (`paths` of the result).

payout_q05.description:
Quantiles of the undiscounted total payout per path (fraction of
notional, as `StructuredNoteSamplePath.payout`), same quantile
definition as `StructuredNoteQuantiles`.

sample_paths.description:
The first `sample_paths` paths in simulation order (with antithetic:
path, its antithetic, next path, ...); empty when 0.

stage.description:
`market_build` (curves, quanto curves, grid, processes),
`simulation` (path generation and payoff walk together: the path
engine hands each path to the walk as it is generated, so the two
are not separable), `deterministic_forward`, `correlation_one`,
`correlation_zero` (the extra runs of `checks`, present only when
run), `diagnostics` (sorting and summarising the per-path records),
and with `greeks` one stage per bumped run: `greek_spot_up_<id>`,
`greek_spot_down_<id>`, `greek_vol_<id>` per underlying,
`greek_correlation` (two or more underlyings), `greek_funding`,
`greek_rate`.

total_milliseconds.description:
Wall-clock time of the whole note, from the first market lookup to
the last diagnostic (the stages' sum plus the untimed remainder).

quantra_StructuredNoteResult.description:
Pricing result of one structured note. The headline is `npv` with its
standard error, the path count and the seed; the terms echo, the
seasoning resolution and the model echo are always present so the
booked terms can be checked before the price is trusted; Greeks and
the diagnostic blocks are present only when requested. For a note whose
past already decided it (`seasoning.status` Called or Matured) nothing
is simulated: `paths` is 0 and every simulation statistic is absent.

npv.description: Present value in the note currency.

standard_error.description:
Monte Carlo standard error of `npv`; absent when nothing was
simulated.

paths.description: Paths actually simulated (0 when nothing was).

event_probabilities.description:
One entry per simulated event, in order; empty when nothing was
simulated.

p_barrier_breach.description:
Probability that the capital barrier is breached; absent when
nothing was simulated.

expected_life_years.description:
Expected time to the note's end in years from the valuation date;
absent when nothing was simulated.

quantra_PriceStructuredNoteResponse.description: Response wrapper for multiple structured notes, in request order.

quantra_SwaptionResponse.description: Swaption pricing response with NPV, Greeks, and diagnostics.

npv.description: Present value of the swaption under the selected model and market inputs.

implied_volatility.description:
Implied volatility reported by the engine. For non-constant vol setups this may be a best-effort value.
Absent when the engine provides none.

atm_forward.description:
ATM forward swap rate used for pricing diagnostics. Present only with
swaption_pricing_details.

annuity.description:
Underlying swap annuity (PV01-style quantity). Present only with
swaption_pricing_details.

delta.description:
Analytic forward delta (swaption_pricing_details): change in NPV for a 1bp
move of the forward swap rate, annuity held fixed (Black/Bachelier
deltaForward x annuity x 1e-4). Currency per bp. Absent unless
swaption_pricing_details is set (the rebump path does not compute it).

vega.description:
Vega: change in NPV for a 1bp (1e-4) move of the quoted volatility
(lognormal vol for Black, normal vol for Bachelier). Currency per bp of vol.
swaption_pricing_details: analytic (calculator vega x annuity x 1e-4).
swaption_pricing_rebump: central difference of a +/-1bp vol bump.
When both flags are set the rebump value is reported. Absent when neither
flag is set.

gamma.description:
Gamma per bp^2. swaption_pricing_details: analytic d2NPV/dF2 of the forward
swap rate x 1e-8, annuity held fixed. swaption_pricing_rebump: second
difference of a +/-1bp parallel curve bump (npvUp - 2 npv + npvDown).
When both flags are set the rebump value is reported. Absent when neither
flag is set.

theta.description:
Theta in currency per calendar day. swaption_pricing_details: pure time
decay of the option premium with forward, volatility and annuity held fixed
(-1/2 sigma^2 F^2 Gamma for Black, -1/2 sigma_N^2 Gamma for Bachelier,
per year, divided by 365). swaption_pricing_rebump: NPV(as_of + 1 calendar
day) - NPV(as_of) from a full market roll. When both flags are set the
rebump value is reported. Absent when neither flag is set.

dv01.description:
DV01 in currency per bp. swaption_pricing_details: equals `delta` (forward
rate moved 1bp, annuity held fixed). swaption_pricing_rebump: central
difference of a +/-1bp parallel bump of the discounting and forwarding
curves (forward and annuity both move). When both flags are set the rebump
value is reported. Absent when neither flag is set.

used_volatility.description: Volatility actually queried from the resolved vol surface.

used_option_expiry.description: Option expiry date used by surface lookup (ISO date).

used_swap_tenor.description: Swap tenor descriptor used by lookup (e.g., date range).

used_strike.description: Strike used to query the volatility structure.

used_atm_forward.description:
ATM forward used when smile conventions need ATM anchoring. Absent when the
vol surface carries no ATM levels.

used_spread_from_atm.description:
Difference between used strike and cube ATM level. Absent unless the
surface uses spread-from-ATM strikes and an ATM level is available.

used_cube_node_atm.description: ATM level retrieved from cube node. Absent when no ATM level is available.

used_hw_a.description: Effective Hull-White mean reversion "a" used by pricing. Absent when model is not HullWhiteLattice.

used_hw_sigma.description: Effective Hull-White sigma used by pricing. Absent when model is not HullWhiteLattice.

used_hw_rmse.description: Calibration RMSE for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

used_hw_num_helpers.description: Number of calibration helpers for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

used_hw_grid_rows.description: Calibration grid rows for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

used_hw_grid_cols.description: Calibration grid columns for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

used_hw_grid_points.description: Calibration grid points for inline-calibrated Hull-White. Absent when no inline calibration.

diagnostics.description:
Per-surface diagnostics, one entry per unique SABR-kind vol surface
referenced by the priced swaptions. Populated only when the request
sets `include_diagnostics=true`. Empty/absent otherwise.

quantra_VanillaSwapResponse.description:
Vanilla swap pricing result. With, for leg i, L_i the leg's flows in its
own frame (coupons +, initial exchange -N_i at the schedule start, final
exchange +N_i with the last coupon; no exchanges unless the leg asks for
them), D_i its discounting curve and s_i = -1 for `Pay` / +1 for
`Receive`:
legs[i].npv           = s_i * CashFlows::npv(L_i, D_i)
legs[i].npv_reporting = legs[i].npv                (one currency)
npv                   = legs[0].npv + legs[1].npv
`fair_rate` holds the floating leg and every exchange fixed and solves the
linear equation in the fixed rate with the fixed leg's signed annuity
B_0 = s_0 * CashFlows::bps(coupons of leg 0, D_0) (exchanges excluded):
fair_rate = rate_0 - npv / (B_0 / 1e-4)
which is QuantLib::VanillaSwap's own fair-rate formula, so repricing at
`fair_rate` gives npv = 0 to rounding (for a CMS floating leg the same
formula applies, the CMS coupons being held fixed). `fair_spread` is the
mirror image on the floating leg: with B_1 = s_1 * CashFlows::bps(coupons
of leg 1, D_1),
fair_spread = spread_1 - npv / (B_1 / 1e-4)
which is QuantLib::VanillaSwap's own fair-spread formula. Every value is
as of the evaluation date (the curves' reference date); flows on that
date are excluded, as for every swap. Positive `npv` is in favour of the
reported party (the one whose `pay_receive` sides were given).

npv.description:
Total present value in the legs' currency, positive in favour of the
reported party.

fair_rate.description:
The fixed rate that zeroes `npv`, the floating leg and every exchange
held fixed. Absent when the fixed leg's annuity is zero (nothing to
solve for) or the value is not finite.

fair_spread.description:
The spread on the floating leg (`IborCoupons` or `CmsCoupons`) that
zeroes `npv`, the fixed leg and every exchange held fixed (the
floating coupons' forwards unchanged). Present on every priced vanilla
swap whose floating leg's annuity is non-zero and the value finite,
as for every swap endpoint: `fair_rate` iff exactly one leg carries
`FixedCoupons`, `fair_spread` iff a leg carries `IborCoupons`,
`OvernightCoupons` or `CmsCoupons`. For a CMS leg with a `cap` or
`floor` the cap / floor strikes are held where the request put them
(the linear solve on the coupon annuity), so repricing a capped or
floored CMS leg at `fair_spread` zeroes `npv` only to first order.

legs.description:
One result per leg, in request order (`fixed_leg` then
`floating_leg`): the leg's signed NPV and, with `include_flows`, its
flows.

used_cms_mean_reversion.description: Effective CMS mean reversion used by the pricer. Absent when no CMS leg.

used_cms_hagan_lower_limit.description: Effective Numeric Hagan lower integration limit. Absent when not applicable.

used_cms_hagan_upper_limit.description: Effective Numeric Hagan upper integration limit. Absent when not applicable.

used_cms_hagan_precision.description: Effective Numeric Hagan integration precision. Absent when not applicable.

used_cms_hagan_hard_upper_limit.description: Effective Numeric Hagan hard upper integration limit. Absent when not applicable.

quantra_PriceVanillaSwapResponse.description: Response wrapper for multiple vanilla swaps, in request order.

quantra_YoYInflationCapFloorResponse.description: Year-on-year inflation cap/floor pricing response (one per instrument).

atm_rate.description:
At-the-money year-on-year rate for the strip, from
QuantLib::YoYInflationCapFloor::atmRate over the discount curve.

quantra_PriceYearOnYearInflationCapFloor.description: Response wrapper for multiple year-on-year inflation cap/floor trades.

quantra_PriceYearOnYearInflationSwapResp.description: Response wrapper for multiple YYIIS trades.

accrued_amount.description: Accrued interest at settlement (0 for a zero-coupon bond by construction).

yield.description: Yield-to-maturity under the request's Yield convention.

quantra_PriceZeroCouponBondResponse.description: Response wrapper for multiple zero-coupon bonds.

quantra_PriceZeroCouponInflationSwapResp.description: Response wrapper for multiple ZCIIS trades.

fixed_leg_npv.description: Present value of the single fixed cashflow.

floating_leg_npv.description: Present value of the single compounded floating cashflow.

fair_fixed_payment.description: The fixed payment that makes the contract par (NPV == 0).

fair_fixed_rate.description:
The par fixed rate. Present only when the request used the fixed-rate
form (it is quoted under that form's day counter). Absent for the
fixed-payment form.

fixed_payment.description: The fixed payment actually used to price the contract.

quantra_PriceZeroCouponSwapResponse.description: Response wrapper for multiple zero-coupon swaps.
